name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.7 degrees north of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 22 times in 7 visits over 67 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 44 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.8 days starting 2026-01-01, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 4.74 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
